questions.question: When inspecting the inside of a bus, you should:

options.text: Skip checking the handrails and floor.
Check that emergency exits are easy to use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check that emergency exits are easy to use.
questions.explanation: When inspecting a bus inside, make sure everything is safe. Check that emergency exits are clearly marked and easy to open.

questions.question: You can avoid distracted driving by:
questions.correctAnswerText: Pre-programming radio stations.
questions.explanation: You can avoid distracted driving by pre-programming radio stations, planning your route ahead, avoiding difficult conversations while driving, adjusting mirrors before leaving, and not eating, drinking, or smoking while you drive.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle, you should:

options.text: Not apply brakes if the vehicle is out of gear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Apply the parking brake.
questions.explanation: Always apply the parking brake when you park. If needed, place wheel chocks under the tires.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, you must check all of the following except:

options.text: That the oil pressure gauge works.
That the oil pressure warning light turns off or the gauge shows normal pressure.
That the oil temperature gauge rises to normal operating range.
That the oil pressure gauge comes on when you use the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the oil pressure gauge comes on when you use the brakes.
questions.explanation: Check that the oil pressure gauge works and shows normal or increasing pressure. The warning light should turn off. If the vehicle has an oil temperature gauge, it should rise to the normal operating range.

questions.question: The suspension system:

options.text: Holds up the vehicle and its load.
Keeps the load at a safe distance behind the driver.
Maintains distance between your vehicle and other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Holds up the vehicle and its load.
questions.explanation: The suspension system holds up a vehicle and its load while keeping the axles in place. Problems with the suspension are very dangerous.

questions.question: If a vehicle has power steering, check the hoses for:

options.text: Whether they are connected to the battery.
The right amount of brake fluid.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leaks.
questions.explanation: When inspecting a vehicle with power steering, check the hoses, pumps, and fluid level. Look carefully for any leaks in the hoses.

questions.question: You should not use your mirrors to:

options.text: Check how fast you are traveling.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check how fast you are traveling.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly, especially when changing lanes, turning, merging, or making tight maneuvers. Do not use mirrors to check your speed.

questions.question: Driving at night is:

options.text: Safer than driving during the day.
Just as safe as driving during the day.
More dangerous than driving during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: More dangerous than driving during the day.
questions.explanation: Driving at night is more dangerous because it is harder to see hazards in the dark.

questions.question: If your vehicle hydroplanes, you should:

options.text: Release the gas pedal and push in the clutch.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the gas pedal and push in the clutch.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle hydroplanes, slow down by releasing the gas pedal and pushing in the clutch.

questions.question: When turning quickly to avoid something in the road, you should:

options.text: Brake and steer at the same time.
Turn more than needed to clear the object.
Turn only as much as needed to miss the object.
Steer and speed up at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn only as much as needed to miss the object.
questions.explanation: When turning to avoid an object, turn only enough to clear it. Do not turn more than necessary. Do not brake while turning.

questions.question: If you must drive very slowly, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Warn other drivers.
questions.explanation: If you must drive slowly, turn on your emergency flashers to warn drivers behind you. Check local laws first to make sure this is permitted.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, you must identify all of the following, except:
questions.correctAnswerText: The water compressor belt.
questions.explanation: Check the power steering belt, water pump belt, alternator belt, and air compressor belt for damage or wear. Look for cracks, frays, or loose fit. If a part is not belt-driven, tell the examiner and verify it works properly and has no damage.

questions.question: Before entering a curve, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Downshift.
questions.explanation: Always downshift before entering a curve. This gives you better control of the vehicle.

questions.question: When arriving at a destination, tell passengers all of the following, except:

options.text: The number of passengers who should get off the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: The number of passengers who should get off the bus.
questions.explanation: Announce the location, reason for stopping, next departure time, and bus number when arriving at a stop or final destination.

questions.question: The shipper is responsible for a vehicle's safe operation.
questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: The driver is responsible for safely operating the vehicle and delivering cargo on time.

questions.question: If one-fourth of the leaves in a leaf spring are missing during an inspection:

options.text: The driver can drive, but only at reduced speeds.
The vehicle must be put out-of-service until repaired.
The vehicle is fine to drive since most of the spring is still there.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle must be put out-of-service until repaired.
questions.explanation: Check leaf springs for broken or missing leaves. This is dangerous. If one-fourth or more of the leaves are missing, take the vehicle out-of-service immediately.

questions.question: Suspension system defects may include all of the following, except:
questions.correctAnswerText: Cracked lights.
questions.explanation: Check the suspension for cracked or broken spring hangers, missing or broken leaves, and leaking shock absorbers. Have any of these issues repaired right away.

questions.question: An encroachment occurs when:

options.text: A driver does not show up for their basic skills test.
A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
A driver fails one section of the basic skills test.

questions.correctAnswerText: A vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
questions.explanation: An encroachment is when any part of your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line during the basic vehicle control skills test. Each encroachment counts as an error.

questions.question: A sign that your vehicle's brakes need repair is:

options.text: The brake pads are not covered in grease.
The brake pads are not covered in oil.
The brake pads are worn thin.

questions.correctAnswerText: The brake pads are worn thin.
questions.explanation: Check brakes for cracked drums, shoes or pads with oil or grease on them, and worn thin shoes. Any of these issues means brake repair is needed.

questions.question: When temperature rises and ice starts to melt on a cool day:

options.text: It is usually safe to drive.
The road becomes even more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes even more slippery.
questions.explanation: As ice melts, water sits on top of it, making the road even more slippery. Slow down and drive with caution on slippery surfaces.
